text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Dart SDK
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - name: Install Melos
        uses: bluefireteam/melos-action@v3
        with:
          run-bootstrap: true
          bootstrap-no-example: false
          enforce-lockfile: true

      - name: Generate version file
        run: dart run packages/marionette_mcp/bin/generate_version.dart

      - name: Verify version file unchanged
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Check Dart formatting
        run: dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .

      - name: Run Dart analyzer
        run: dart analyze --fatal-infos

      - name: Run tests
        run: melos exec --no-bash -c "dart test"

      - name: CodeQL init
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: dart

      - name: CodeQL autobuild
        uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3

      - name: CodeQL analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
```
